title: lamium album subsp. transcaucasicum
intro: Lamium album subsp. transcaucasicum, commonly known as White Spurred Violet, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The bioactive constituents of Lamium album subsp. transcaucasicum include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is necessary to confirm the efficacy and safety of this plant for therapeutic use.
